school: 中华人民共和国开国总理/统一战线与外交艺术大师/务实协调型政治家
historical_significance: 周恩来（1898—1976），字翔宇，原籍浙江绍兴，生于江苏淮安，中华人民共和国开国总理，任职二十六年余。青年时求学南开、留学日本与欧洲，1921年加入中国共产党，是旅欧党组织的主要创建者。1927年领导南昌起义，此后长期主持中共中央组织、情报与统战工作；西安事变中力主和平解决，促成抗日民族统一战线；抗战时期长驻重庆代表中共与国民党周旋，主持南方局工作。建国后任政府总理兼首任外交部长，主持第一个五年计划与156项工程，提出并促成和平共处五项原则，1954年日内瓦会议与1955年万隆会议上以'求同存异'扭转会议走向，奠定新中国外交基本盘。1956年主持'既反保守又反冒进'的综合平衡方针；文革十年在极端复杂环境中苦撑危局，保护大批干部、维持国民经济与外交大局运转，1975年重病中在四届人大重申'四个现代化'目标。他以日理万机的组织协调、周密预案的谈判准备、化敌为友的人心政治和鞠躬尽瘁的自我治理著称，'活到老，学到老，改造到老'与'十条家规'成为其人格化领导的注脚。1976年1月8日逝世，遵遗嘱不保留骨灰，撒入江海，百万群众十里长街送别。
historical_significance_en: Zhou Enlai (1898-1976), courtesy name Xiangyu, of Shaoxing, Zhejiang ancestry and born in Huai'an, Jiangsu, was the founding Premier of the People's Republic of China, serving over twenty-six years. Educated at Nankai and in Japan and Europe, he joined the Communist Party in 1921 and was a principal founder of its European organization. He led the Nanchang Uprising in 1927 and long ran the Party center's organization, intelligence, and united-front work; in the Xi'an Incident he pressed for a peaceful settlement, midwifing the anti-Japanese united front, and through the war represented the CCP in Chongqing from the Southern Bureau. As Premier and first Foreign Minister he directed the First Five-Year Plan and its 156 projects, advanced the Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence, and at Geneva in 1954 and Bandung in 1955—'seeking common ground while reserving differences'—turned the conferences around and laid the base of New China's diplomacy. In 1956 he steered the policy of opposing both conservatism and rashness through comprehensive balance; through the decade of the Cultural Revolution he held a crumbling situation together, protecting large numbers of cadres and keeping the economy and diplomacy running, and in 1975, terminally ill, reaffirmed the 'Four Modernizations' at the Fourth NPC. He was famed for round-the-clock coordination, exhaustively prepared negotiation, the winning of hearts that turned foes into friends, and self-governance unto his last breath—'live and learn and remold oneself to the last' and the 'ten family rules' as footnotes to personalized leadership. He died on 8 January 1976; by his wish his ashes were scattered into the rivers and sea, and a million people lined the thoroughfare in farewell.
key_works: 《说真话，鼓真劲，做实事，收实效》（1962年七千人大会讲话）
《周恩来年谱》《周恩来传》（中央文献研究室编）
key_concepts: 说真话鼓真劲做实事收实效

cross_references.relation_type: 战略与执行的双人舞：路线设计者与运转中枢
cross_references.description_zh: 毛泽东与周恩来是现代中国政治史上最典型的'设计者—执行者'搭档：毛负责路线、战略与理论突破，周负责把路线转化为可运转的日常系统（组织、外交、经济调度）。二人互补的深层逻辑：任何革命组织都需要'定义方向的人'与'让系统不熄火的人'，前者提供愿景与张力，后者提供可靠性与缓冲；周恩来对毛泽东的辅佐与在关键节点（如万隆、反冒进）的独立发挥，说明执行枢纽并非被动齿轮，而是在既定方向内拥有自己的方法论创造。
cross_references.description_en: Mao Zedong and Zhou Enlai were the most paradigmatic designer-executor pairing in modern Chinese political history: Mao set the line, strategy, and theoretical breakthroughs; Zhou translated the line into a running daily system—organization, diplomacy, economic dispatch. The deeper logic of the complementarity: any revolutionary organization needs one who defines direction and one who keeps the system from stalling; the former supplies vision and tension, the latter reliability and buffering. Zhou's support of Mao, and his independent play at moments like Bandung and the anti-rash-advance, show that the executive hub is no passive gear but a methodological creator within the set direction.

cross_references.relation_type: 务实主义的代际接力：从求同存异到实事求是
cross_references.description_zh: 周恩来与邓小平同属党内务实传统，但分工各异：周的务实体现在关系与系统的润滑——求同存异、综合平衡、保护干部；邓的务实体现在路线与制度的重构——真理标准、猫论、改革开放。1970年代正是周恩来力主邓小平复出并主持整顿，为改革储备了人事与政治资本。二人共同说明：务实主义在不同层级呈现不同形态——操作层的分寸拿捏与路线层的标准重建，互为条件。
cross_references.description_en: Zhou Enlai and Deng Xiaoping both belonged to the Party's pragmatic tradition, with different divisions of labor: Zhou's pragmatism lay in lubricating relationships and systems—seeking common ground, comprehensive balance, protecting cadres; Deng's lay in rebuilding the line and institutions—the truth criterion, the cat theory, reform and opening. In the 1970s it was Zhou who pressed for Deng's return and his program of rectification, stocking the reform with personnel and political capital. Together they show that pragmatism takes different forms at different levels—proportion at the operational level and reconstructed criteria at the line level are conditions for each other.
